content.text: {"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot \"accessory\" is for an item no other slot fits.", "\"is_outfit\" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following \"answer_schema\", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": ["\"description\" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A structured wool-blend blazer in charcoal gray (#3b4252), tailored with a slight shoulder slope and mid-thigh length for warmth against the snow, paired with high-waisted wide-leg trousers in a matching heavy twill to ensure comfort while walking. A soft silk blouse in cream (#f5f1e8) with a modest round neckline sits underneath, providing a clean layer without exposing any open zones. On feet, sturdy leather ankle boots in oxidized black (#1c1b1a) with a low block heel offer necessary grip on salted frosty roads while respecting her refusal of strappy or open-toed shoes. This outfit works because it strictly adheres to her request for no open areas and no high heels, prioritizing warmth and stability for the snowy commute in a neat professional setting. The layered textures protect against the cold without restricting movement, creating an optimal balance between workplace appropriateness and practicality for walking through winter conditions."}
